title: 第10章 林中寻路第11章 挥之不去的阴影
content_zh:
第十章 林中寻路
作为一个走南闯北的商人，梅斯当然不可能没有见过狼，不过他可以对天发誓，他从出生到现在，还没有见过体形这么大的狼。
单从体形来看，这头巨狼就足有一人高，身上厚厚的毛皮油光发亮，此刻的它正悠闲的眯着眼睛，享受着午后的温暖阳光，粗壮的尾巴在身后甩来甩去，看起来非常的轻松。而莉洁此刻也早已经闭上了嘴巴，屏声静气的跟随在罗德的身后。作为一名佣兵，莉洁当然知道这些猛兽有多么可怕和危险，虽然她没有象胖商人那样紧张到大气都不敢喘一声，但是少女也同样将目光投向了罗德，等待他的命令。
而罗德自己也在思考。
银狼“月魂”，十级精英，虽然不是BOSS属性，可是却也很麻烦，毕竟在龙魂大陆中，除了类人生物之外，怪物的危险性则是以野兽—巨兽—魔兽三个级别来区分的。野兽就是普通的生物，而巨兽则是那些因为生存了很长时间，又或者受到了什么刺激而身体巨大，性格凶猛而危险的怪物。而当它们在觉醒了自己的灵魂力量之后，便会升级为魔兽。而到那个时候，它们就不仅仅只是靠自己的身体来战斗了，而且也更加难缠。
虽然眼前的银狼从威胁级别来说还没有之前的风蛇领主来的高，而对于罗德来说，干掉它并不困难，但是………
想到这里，罗德不由下意识的望了一眼四周。如果换了是在游戏里的话，那么罗德绝对不介意顺手宰掉对方拿点经验捞些材料，不过现在可不是游戏，而且他们也只有三个人，莉洁只是个灵师，并不具备自保的能力。至于梅斯则更是战力外，在这种情况下，多一事不如少一事才是上策。
想到这里，罗德便做了个手势，接着转身向另外一个方向走去，反正月光之湖并不算小，没有必要为了抄近道而特意做些吃力不讨好的事情。而看见他的动作，莉洁和梅斯对望了一眼，随后便也跟随在罗德的身后打算离开。不过很可惜的是，好运似乎并不打算眷顾他们。
“喀碴。”
就在胖商人转身的瞬间，他的脚下猛然一滑，接着重重的跌倒在地，压碎了身下的一根树枝。
而就在这时，只见原本走在最前面的罗德立刻回过头举起自己的右手，很快，伴随着一声清脆的鸟鸣，翠绿的身影从他的手中激射而出，直扑向两人的后方。
“轰！！”
伴随着撞击声，从两人身后传来了一声低低的嚎叫，莉洁和梅斯转过头去，这才惊讶的发现原本那只本来应该距离他们还有一段距离的白色巨狼居然不知道什么时候已经来到了他们身后，此刻它那巨大的身躯正横躺在地上，似乎受到了什么外力的撞击一般。
接着，一道阴影从两人的身侧闪过。
早在胖商人跌倒的同时，罗德内心就已知不妙，毕竟在银月森林中，这些巨狼的敏锐和感知都是可以排到前三的。不过幸运的是在游戏中罗德已经不止一次遇到猪一般的NPC所带来的状况外的麻烦，而这些经验则在这一刻产生了效果———虽然罗德的感知目前并没有高的可以锁定这些巨兽，但是凭借他对巨狼的熟悉，罗德还是立刻做出了判断，虽然正在休息中的“月魂”不太可能立刻对自己等人发起袭击，但是它绝对察觉到了自己等人的存在，以这些巨狼的特性，多半会悄悄尾随在后，等待天黑之后再发动攻击。它们等的起，但是自己却等不起。与其到时候被动的与这些家伙周旋，还不如主动出击，掌控局势来的有效。
罗德的判断非常正确。
月魂的确没有想到对方居然会这么快发动袭击，面对飞扑而来的灵魂之鸟，它下意识的做出了反应，但却还是慢了一线。青绿色的灵鸟不偏不倚的击中了它的身体，所爆发的冲击波将其重重的打飞开去。
而就在白色巨狼趴在地上，还没有来得及从冲击中回过神来时，启动了影闪的罗德已然来到了它的身侧。他专注的望着眼前的巨狼，随后伸出右手。
“Cage！”（精灵语：转换）
青绿色的鸟儿重新飞回他的手中，化为卡牌，而其颜色也在瞬间由绿转白。罗德没有多看，他反过手去，用力握住手中的卡牌，接着向月魂的右后腿直刺而过。

白色的光束一瞬间刺穿了月魂的右腿，将其重重的钉在了地上，而此刻，通体雪白的长剑，已然出现在了罗德的手中。
“———！！！”
银狼发出了一声痛苦的嚎叫，它张大双眼，死死的盯着眼前这个可恶的人类，同时试图站起身来，但是就在它站稳的同时，却不由的身形一晃，不得不重新稳住。
而就在这时，罗德的第二击已到。
将银狼的动作尽收眼中，罗德也是暗暗放下了心，毕竟这些精英最大的特点就是速度飞快，如果不能够在第一时间废掉它们的这一特点，那么接下来必然是一场苦战。而现在，被废掉了一只后腿的银狼已经没有办法再象刚才那样依靠速度来战斗，那么接下来就简单的多了。
虽然被废掉了一只后腿，但是银狼却并没有因此而惊慌失措，它死死的盯视着眼前的目标，就在罗德一剑直刺而来的同时，它也举起了自己的前爪，对着罗德重重的挥下。
虽然银狼已经做出了反击，但是早已经预料到它的动作的罗德面对眼前的利爪却并没有惊慌失措，相反，他右手一翻，白色的剑锋便顺着银狼的爪下划过，带起了一抹血花。而就在银狼吃痛收爪的同时，它所看见的，只有眼前那甚至比阳光还要耀眼的锐利光刃。
要害攻击！
飞舞的破碎之刃刺穿了它那巨大的躯体，轻而易举的撕裂了原本坚硬的毛皮，伴随着痛苦的哀嚎，白色巨狼飞到空中，撞在一棵小树上之后这才重新跌倒在地。它的半边身体已经被撕裂出了一道血肉模糊的伤口，甚至可以看见里面的森森白骨和正在缓慢流出的内脏。
这副情景的确让人觉得恶心，就连原本打算上去补上最后一击的罗德也不由的皱了皱眉头，毕竟游戏中要害攻击的伤害只是以数据的形式表现出来，而并不是这样鲜明的场景，虽然之前在与风蛇的战斗中已经见过，但是这种东西无论什么时候看，都不会让人心里好过。
受了一击灵魂之鸟的冲击，再加上罗德的极其针对性的攻击，使得黑色巨狼已经到达了临界点，原本充满威胁的怒嚎此刻已经变成了低微的哀鸣，它用力的支持着身体，试图重新站起身来。但是罗德并没有给它这个机会，只是手起剑落，将星痕刺入了它的脑中，果断的夺走了它的生命。
虽然看起来很漫长，但是事实上才过了短短一两分钟，对于莉洁和梅斯来说，他们眼中所看见的就是那只银狼被打翻在地，接着罗德出现在了它的身边，短短几剑便干脆利落的结束了它的生命。这让两人都是惊讶无比，要知道这可是一头巨狼，它可不是那么容易对付的。莉洁自问哪怕是自己所在的佣兵团，即便是在人员齐备的情况下，恐怕也很难如此轻松的杀掉一只巨狼。但是看看罗德的表现，那哪里象是在杀狼？简直轻松的和杀鸡没有什么区别！
至于胖商人的心情就更是复杂，要知道刚才他跌倒的时候，心里就已经是一阵冰冷，他当然知道这代表着什么，也害怕那只狼会察觉到他们的存在，但是他猜到了过程，却没有猜到结局，虽然那只银狼的确察觉到了他们，但是却还没有来得及将自己的食欲付之行动，就悲剧的变成了一具尸体………
虽然危险已经解除，不过胖商人依旧内心深处七上八下，忐忑不安的望着眼前不远处的年轻人，他明白这是自己的错，万一对方翻脸把他扔在这里可怎么办？要是换了平时他也不担心这些问题，毕竟那个时候围绕在自己身边的都是自己花钱雇来的侍卫，就算自己出点小错也不担心会被人说什么。但是现在不同，这个年轻人可不是什么侍卫和佣兵，他和自己的关系完全是平等的，要是他不爽了完全可以把自己扔在这里管都不管。到那个时候自己就完蛋了！
“这个……我………我不是………”
想到这里，胖商人只感觉自己的背上出了一身冷汗，他舔了舔干裂的嘴唇，打算说些什么，但是却什么都说不出来。而就在这时，他看见罗德重新站起来，接着转过身，面色平静的望了他一眼。
“走路小心点。”
于是胖商人发现自己除了点头，也没有什么可做的了………

Chapter 10 Finding the Way in the Forest
As a traveling businessman, it was certainly impossible for Metz to have never seen a wolf, but he could swear to God that he had never seen such a big wolf since he was born.
Judging from the size alone, this giant wolf is as tall as a person, and its thick fur is shiny. At this moment, it is squinting its eyes leisurely, enjoying the warm afternoon sunshine, and its thick tail is swinging behind it, looking very relaxed. Li Jie had already closed her mouth at this moment and followed Rhodes silently. As a mercenary, Li Jie certainly knew how terrifying and dangerous these beasts were. Although she was not as nervous as the fat businessman and did not dare to breathe, the girl also set her sights on Rhodes and waited for his orders.
And Rhodes himself was thinking.
Silver Wolf "Moon Soul", a tenth-level elite, although not a BOSS attribute, is still very troublesome. After all, in the Dragon Soul Continent, in addition to humanoid creatures, the danger of monsters is divided into three levels: beasts, giant beasts, and magical beasts. Beasts are ordinary creatures, while behemoths are monsters that are huge, ferocious and dangerous because they have survived for a long time or were stimulated by something. And when they awaken their soul power, they will upgrade into monsters. And by that time, they will not only rely on their own bodies to fight, but they will also become more difficult to deal with.
Although the threat level of the silver wolf in front of him is not as high as that of the previous wind snake lord, and it is not difficult for Rhodes to kill it, but...
Thinking of this, Rhodes couldn't help but glance around subconsciously. If it were in a game, then Rhodes would definitely not mind killing the opponent to get some experience and get some materials. However, this is not a game now, and there are only three of them. Li Jie is just a spiritual master and does not have the ability to protect herself. As for Metz, he is even less capable. In this case, it is better to do more than to do less.
Thinking of this, Rhodes made a gesture, then turned around and walked in another direction. The Moonlight Lake was not that small anyway, so there was no need to do thankless things just to take a shortcut. Seeing his actions, Li Jie and Metz looked at each other, and then followed Rhodes to leave. But unfortunately, it seems that good luck is not going to favor them.
"Kata."
The moment the fat businessman turned around, his feet suddenly slipped, and then he fell heavily to the ground, crushing a branch under him.
At this moment, Rhodes, who was walking in front, immediately turned around and raised his right hand. Soon, with a crisp bird song, an emerald green figure shot out from his hand and rushed towards the back of the two people.
"Boom!!"
Along with the impact, a low howl came from behind the two of them. Li Jie and Mace turned their heads, and were surprised to find that the giant white wolf that was supposed to be some distance away from them had arrived behind them without knowing it. At this moment, its huge body was lying on the ground, as if it had been hit by some external force.
Then, a shadow flashed past the two of them.
As early as when the fat businessman fell, Rhodes knew something was wrong. After all, in the Silver Moon Forest, the acuity and perception of these giant wolves can be ranked among the top three. Fortunately, Rhodes has encountered troubles caused by pig-like NPCs more than once in the game, and these experiences have taken effect at this moment - although Rhodes' perception is not high enough to target these giant beasts, but with his familiarity with giant wolves, Rhodes still made an immediate judgment. Although the resting "Moon Soul" is unlikely to immediately attack himself and others, it is definitely aware of the existence of himself and others. With these giant wolvesCharacteristics, most of them will follow behind quietly, waiting for dark before launching an attack. They can afford to wait, but they cannot afford to wait. Rather than passively dealing with these guys, it would be more effective to take the initiative and control the situation.
Rhodes's judgment was very correct.
Yuehun really didn't expect that the other party would launch an attack so quickly. Facing the soul bird flying towards it, it reacted subconsciously, but it was still a little slow. The turquoise spirit bird hit its body impartially, and the resulting shock wave knocked it away heavily.
And just when the giant white wolf was lying on the ground, before it had time to recover from the impact, Rhodes, who had activated Shadow Flash, had already arrived at its side. He looked at the giant wolf in front of him intently, and then stretched out his right hand.
"Cage!" (Elvish: Conversion)
The green bird flew back into his hand and turned into a card, and its color also changed from green to white in an instant. Rhodes didn't look at it. He turned around, held the card in his hand firmly, and then stabbed Yuehun's right hind leg.
The white beam of light instantly pierced Yuehun's right leg, nailing it heavily to the ground. At this moment, the snow-white long sword appeared in Rhode's hand.
“————!!!”
The silver wolf let out a howl of pain. It opened its eyes wide and stared at the hateful human in front of it. At the same time, it tried to stand up, but just as it stood firm, it couldn't help but swayed and had to regain its balance.
At this moment, Rhodes' second attack arrived.
After seeing the movements of Silver Wolf, Rhodes was secretly relieved. After all, the biggest feature of these elites was their fast speed. If they could not abolish this feature at the first time, then the next step would be a hard battle. But now, Silver Wolf, who had lost one of his hind legs, could no longer rely on speed to fight as before, so the next step would be much simpler.
Although one of its hind legs was lost, the silver wolf did not panic. It stared at the target in front of it. Just as Rhodes stabbed straight at him, it also raised its front paw and swung it hard at Rhodes.
Although the silver wolf had already made a counterattack, Rhodes, who had already anticipated its action, did not panic when faced with the sharp claws in front of him. On the contrary, he turned his right hand and the white sword edge passed under the silver wolf's claws, bringing with it a splash of blood. And when the silver wolf was in pain and retracted its claws, all it saw was the sharp blade of light in front of it that was even more dazzling than the sun.
Critical attack!
The flying broken blade pierced its huge body, easily tearing apart the originally tough fur. With a painful cry, the giant white wolf flew into the air, hit a small tree, and then fell to the ground again. Half of its body has been torn with a bloody wound, and you can even see the dense white bones and internal organs that are slowly flowing out.
This scene was indeed disgusting, and even Rhodes, who had originally planned to go up to make up for the final blow, couldn't help but frown. After all, the damage of key attacks in the game was only shown in the form of data, not such a vivid scene. Although he had seen it before in the battle with the wind snake, no matter when he saw this kind of thing, it would not make people feel better.
After receiving a blow from the Soul Bird, coupled with Rhodes' extremely targeted attack, the black giant wolf had reached the critical point. The originally threatening roar had now turned into a low whine. It supported its body vigorously and tried to stand up again. But Rhodes didn't give it this chance. He just raised his sword and stabbed the star mark into its brain, decisively taking away its life.
Although it seems to be a long time, in fact, only a minute or two has passed. For Li Jie and Metz, in their eyesWhat he saw was that the silver wolf was knocked to the ground, and then Rhodes appeared next to it, and ended its life neatly with just a few swords. This surprised both of them. You must know that this is a giant wolf, and it is not so easy to deal with. Li Jie asked herself that even the mercenary group she belonged to, even with all the personnel, would probably be difficult to kill a giant wolf so easily. But looking at Rhodes' performance, how does it look like he is killing a wolf? It's just as easy as killing a chicken!
As for the fat businessman, his mood was even more complicated. You must know that when he fell just now, his heart was already cold. Of course he knew what it meant and was afraid that the wolf would notice their existence. However, he guessed the process but not the ending. Although the silver wolf did notice them, he tragically turned into a corpse before he could act on his appetite...
Although the danger has been removed, the fat businessman is still anxious in his heart and looks at the young man not far away uneasily. He understands that it is his fault. What if the other party turns against him and leaves him here? Normally, he wouldn't worry about these problems. After all, he was surrounded by guards he paid for at that time. Even if he made a small mistake, he wouldn't worry about what others would say. But it's different now. This young man is not a guard or a mercenary. His relationship with him is completely equal. If he is unhappy, he can just leave him here and take care of him. By then you will be finished!
"This...I...I'm not..."
Thinking of this, the fat businessman felt a cold sweat break out on his back. He licked his chapped lips and planned to say something, but nothing came out. At this moment, he saw Rhodes standing up again, then turned around and looked at him calmly.
"Be careful when you walk."
So the fat businessman found that he had nothing to do except nod...
